objectives: TEST DATA. Find out whether people look under Orders for a refund.
researchQuestions: TEST DATA. Where would people go to get their money back?

recruitment.channel: A panel of the existing users

hypotheses.statement: People look under Orders to get their money back.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Most participants choose the refunds node in tt1.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Fewer than half of the participants choose the refunds node in tt1.

hypotheses.statement: People find where to change their delivery address.
hypotheses.supportedIf: Most participants choose the addresses node in tt2.
hypotheses.refutedIf: Fewer than half choose the addresses node in tt2.

instrument.intro: TEST DATA. You will see a list of menus. For each question, pick the place where you would look first.
instrument.consent: TEST DATA. Your choices are kept without your name.

questions.text: TEST DATA. You were charged twice for one parcel and want your money back. Where would you go?
TEST DATA. You moved house and want parcels to arrive at the new place. Where would you go?
